title: Prove sharp 14-ADD relocated-output G20 boundaries and repair allowance
body:
The pinned PR5840 G20 boundary has an exact 14-ADD minimum when outputs may occupy declared fixed relocated wires. The proof covers either side, any number of independent ports, cross-port gates and arbitrary extra clean/dirty wires. Explicit words and output maps attain the bound. This answers the scalar subproblem in PR6656's open relocated-output question.

Separate repair to the original labels costs exactly 24 more ADDs per side. The package also derives the exact changed-core obligation `L Q R = A (S Q S) A^-1`. A physical implementation of the conjugated core must beat the 48-ADD two-sided allowance, including every changed consumer fee, before there is a supplier saving. No such physical implementation or new κ is claimed. All five selected assumptions and selected frontier remain unchanged.

The assigned `bit-helper-contract` card is explicitly CHANGED to this source-bound boundary result after reading PR5679/5708 and later overlap. Credit Ali Romman/5840, Charan ./5851, JoyboyBrian/6105, unpaidmoon/6641, Nick Petalas/6656 and the retained G20/native/controller lineage. The general destination-count and gate-relabelling methods are elementary; the separate repair floor credits Bu, Fan and Joo and its predecessor source applications. PR6811 and PR6812 are neither resumed nor repackaged.

Validation on Linux with CPython 3.12.9:

- Registered normal/optimized replay passes; result packets match.
- Exact endpoints, all independent columns plus dirty extras, p=1,2,3,111 witnesses, 28 omitted-gate and 32 wrong-location rejections pass.
- Complete GL(4,F2) census: 20,160 states and 241,920 projected output checks; free-permutation quotient: 840 states; changed-core identity: all 1,024 formal matrix entries.
- Committed-byte/source-history preflight and official eight-member export with one declared input pass. Read-only Git-free, empty-PATH normal/optimized export replays pass. Final publication preflight repeated after metadata-only edits.
- Final scientific replay measured 0.36 seconds / 24,136 KiB peak RSS on this host. This is one measurement, not a portable bound.

Reproduce with `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/g20-relocated-output-floor`. See package `VALIDATION.json` for exact commands, development corrections, environment and limits. No predecessor scientific checker, broad historical replay, Lean or Docker was run. This is solo author-checked proof plus finite corroboration, without independent review, human acceptance or proof-kernel acceptance. Hosted CI is separate from these local results.

Canonical main refreshed at submission remains `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, priority revision 8. Final complete reported overlap covered 762 open PRs and 6,887 Discussion records; 8,917 committed local notes were inventoried. No equivalent result was found in the targeted coverage; arbitrary diffs, unpublished work and literature-wide novelty are unclaimed. Canonical investigation: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5804#discussioncomment-19448686.

Prepared for zhaobenny with substantial AI assistance in derivation, implementation, verification and writing. Produced with OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol at high reasoning effort through Codex. No subagents were used.
